queue.question: Which current UE 5.8, SideFX Karma, and modern atmosphere/whole-atmosphere ideas are transferable into KAOPU as vendor-independent atmosphere/lighting semantics and evaluator contracts without copying engine implementations or defaults?
queue.progress: R01-R06 established state/evaluator separation, ground-to-space semantics, query-scoped evaluator validity, multi-root Earth references, evidence dependency, per-quantity validity, typed Missing/Unsupported, and split-overlap semantics. R07 locked Takram reference-frame/evaluator architecture. R08 defined typed Weather vertical coordinates. R09 separated coordinate conversion from spatial retarget and split RuntimeCloudPlacement, CloudOpticalClosure and EvaluatorBudget. R10 defined minimum CloudOpticalClosure sufficiency and identified NASA MERRA-2 source-native path optics as a lower-assumption global experiment route. R11 established aggregation/representativeness validity and rejected direct promotion of coarse three-hour path optics to instantaneous local-volume truth. R12 selected the alternative next-gate route and evaluated NOAA HRRR as a higher-temporal/higher-spatial regional operational source. Official NOAA/NCEP evidence shows 3 km native-level HRRR output, hourly model runs, 50 hybrid levels carrying CLWMR/CIMIXR/NCONCD/NCCICE/FRACCC/PRES/HGT/TMP/SPFH, and a separate sub-hourly product explicitly classified as 2-D Surface Levels. A live 2026-09-09 NOMADS native-analysis index confirmed the selected field family through hybrid level 50; the full sampled native analysis was about 667 MB, showing why subset/preprocessing capability matters. The R12 semantic probe passed 7/7: HRRR materially reduces the nominal source-support gap versus MERRA-2 but still remains about 30x coarser than a test-only 100 m local-volume footprint, model analysis remains model-derived rather than Observation truth, 2-D support cannot identify a unique 3-D profile, and microphysics readiness does not imply renderer optical closure. Candidate WeatherSourceCapabilityContract, QuerySupportMatch, SourceFederationPolicy and SourceLifecycleState were added. NOAA's 2026 RRFS transition/preliminary product state is retained as lifecycle/migration evidence rather than permission for a silent provider swap. No production Mother branch was modified.
queue.nextGate: Keep three gates distinct. Physical-reference gate: authoritative NRLMSIS 2.1 numerical confirmation plus a tiny authenticated HITRAN checkpoint set. Runtime-atmosphere gate: one KAOPU ReferenceFrame + RuntimeAtmospherePacket consumed by two evaluator adapters. Weather-coupling gate: R12 establishes query-scoped, lifecycle-aware source routing and identifies HRRR as a materially stronger regional operational microphysics constraint than MERRA-2 for current CONUS Weather, without treating it as global or local-volume truth. Next materialize one small official HRRR native GRIB2 subset for a selected region/time containing at least PRES/HGT/CLWMR/CIMIXR/NCONCD/NCCICE/FRACCC/TMP with exact GRIB support/vertical metadata; derive one explicit candidate visible-light CloudOpticalClosure with formula/model/assumption uncertainty; create DerivedSyntheticDisaggregation only if a finer local packet is required; then feed the same optical packet to two evaluator adapters and report source/model, support/disaggregation, optical-closure, numerical/visual and performance errors separately. Keep global fallback/source federation and HRRR-to-RRFS lifecycle migration as separate work. Candidate-complete promotion requires all applicable gates; Frozen promotion remains a separate Judgment event.
